definitions.explanation: Text or writing in the English language.
The study of English literature (often as an academic subject).

examples.japanese: この{英文|えいぶん}を{日本語|にほんご}に{訳|やく}してください。
examples.english: Please translate this English text into Japanese.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{大学|だいがく}で{英文|えいぶん}{学|がく}を{専攻|せんこう}した。
examples.english: She majored in English literature at university.

examples.japanese: {英文|えいぶん}を{読|よ}むのは{得意|とくい}だが{書|か}くのは{苦手|にがて}だ。
examples.english: I'm good at reading English but not at writing it.

notes:
USAGE: {英文|えいぶん} can refer to any text written in English or to English literature as an academic field.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{英文|えいぶん}{学|がく} (English literature - academic)
・{英文|えいぶん}{法|ほう} (English composition/grammar)
・{英文|えいぶん}{科|か} (English department)
・{英文|えいぶん}{和訳|わやく} (English-to-Japanese translation)

CONTRAST:
・{英文|えいぶん} vs {英語|えいご} - {英語|えいご} is the language itself, while {英文|えいぶん} refers specifically to written text
・{和文|わぶん} - Japanese text (opposite)
